turns.question: What share of all orders placed between 17 August and 2 October 2026 were cancelled?
turns.answer: The cancellation rate was 9.5% (0.095) of orders placed from 17 August to 2 October 2026, inclusive. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
